maria: Quick kickoff 1: webinar Apr 7. Need X + LinkedIn schedule, hero image variants, 1-line hook for CTA, and SDR routing. :calendar:

sam: Ill draft 2 hooks (cost vs reliability) and 3 thread opens by EOD.

leo: Routing: all social links must include UTM params for campaign and variant. SDR queue should get warm leads; flag 'social_webinar' on intake.

sdr-triage: Got it. Recommend utm_medium=x_social, utm_campaign=webinar_apr7, utm_content={variant}. We'll auto-tag and escalate heavy-engagers to SDR.

maria: A/B messaging: Hook A = latency/cost. Hook B = reliability/rollouts. Sam, keep both tight for X.

sam: Drafts:
- Hook A (short): "Lower inference cost. Faster responses."
- Hook B (short): "Keep LLMs reliable at scale."
Thread opener examples ready in scheduler drafts.

jess: If assets miss deadline, fallback = text-only post + screenshot. Please include fallback copy.

leo: Tentative schedule:
- Apr 1 09:00 PT: Teaser (X + LI)
- Apr 3 11:00 PT: Thread deep-dive (X)
- Apr 6 10:00 PT: Reminder (X + LI)
- Apr 7 morning + noon: Live day push (X)
Make sure scheduler timezone metadata is set.

maria: Ops: can we get a tracking pixel on reg page? @ops-bot ping frontend.

ops-bot: @frontend-team Please add marketing pixel flag to webinar reg page. Ticket WEB-3421.

sam: Post-webinar follow-up plan: one highlight thread + on-demand link + targeted DM templates for commenters/RTs.

jess: Upload assets to drive + Figma when ready; I'll share links in this thread.

leo: I'll validate CRM UTM ingestion Wed and confirm webhooks.

maria: Final checklist for launch: 1) creative deliverables, 2) hooks A/B finalized, 3) scheduler populated with UTMs, 4) SDR playbook snippets, 5) follow-up DM templates. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
